tasks.label: Build scheduler module (Debug)
args: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE=$(which python3) && cmake --build build && cp build/scheduler*.so .

tasks.label: Build scheduler cli (Debug)
args: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE=$(which python3) && cmake --build build --target scheduler_cli
